source_documents.title: Aggregation-Induced Emission (AIE)-Active Fluorescent Probes with Multi-Binding Sites toward ATP Sensing and the Live Cell Imaging

reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source explicitly distinguishes TPA-PPA-2 from the one- and three-arm congeners and reports its isolation and NMR characterization.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Identity is followed by name/designation only; no chemical graph or legacy SMILES confirmation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The HOMO orbital is mostly dominated in the TPA cores
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PP/TPA-PPA series including TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors report HOMO density on TPA and LUMO on pyridinium acceptors, interpreted as ICT tendency for all four probes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The printed very small gaps labeled eV are questionable in magnitude/unit convention; no numerical gap is adopted or silently corrected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence property is greatly affected by the solvent polarity
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-2 within four-probe series
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solvent study, 20 micromolar, Fig. 3; target excitation 437 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors interpret solvent-dependent emission as probably ICT-related; the target is included in the measured series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Solvent polarity changes can also change hydrogen bonding and aggregation. No TICT geometry or time-resolved CT formation is established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: their fluorescence lifetimes were lengthened to 4.9, 2.9, 4.3 and 4.9 nanoseconds, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 4, target third in TPA-PP/PPA-1/PPA-2/PPA-3 sequence.
reference_evidence_units.statement: TPA-PPA-2 has a reported fluorescence lifetime of 4.3 ns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Inspected caption does not specify the solvent/ATP condition or a before-after pair; do not call 4.3 ns an ATP-induced lifetime increase.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Plots of maximum emission intensity (I/I0) of TPA-PP, TPA- PPA-1, TPA-PPA-2, TPA-PPA-3 with the addition of ATP.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 20 micromolar probe, aqueous 2 vol% DMSO, pH 7.0; ATP 10-300 micromolar, Fig. 5 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target-specific blue-triangle curve increases with added ATP, intermediate between PPA-1 and PPA-3 over the plotted range.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No comparator detection limit, quantum-yield enhancement or selectivity is assigned to PPA-2; plotted intensity response alone does not prove a binding geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: possibly due to the synergistic effect of electrostaticat traction and covalent bonds formation
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA series including TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: ATP-dependent absorption/emission; PP/PPA-1 comparison and multi-binding-site rationale.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose combined pyridinium-phosphate electrostatics and boronic-acid/cis-diol bonding for ATP recognition; extra binding sites are proposed to improve response.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detailed comparator comparison is PP versus PPA-1 and strongest claims concern PPA-3. The PPA-2 binding mode is a bounded series interpretation, not independently resolved stoichiometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Plots of maximum emission intensity of TPA-PP, TPA-PPA-1, TPA-PPA-2, TPA-PPA-3
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fig. 6 visually inspected; 20 micromolar in glycerol/methanol mixtures, glycerol fraction up to 0.95.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The separately labeled PPA-2 blue-triangle curve rises substantially at high glycerol fraction, so viscosity response is observed for this target and not only PPA-3.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Changing glycerol content also changes solvent properties. The photograph inset and quoted approximately fivefold result in the prose concern PPA-3, not PPA-2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of intramolecular rotations (RIR), blocking the non-radiative pathway
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA probe series including TPA-PPA-2; detailed ATP model illustrated by PPA-3
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Interpretation motivating the four-probe glycerol test, followed by PPA-3-specific ATP model.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors invoke RIR to explain viscosity-enhanced emission, and propose that multi-site ATP association also restricts motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: PPA-2 has its own viscosity curve, but the proposed ATP-induced viscosity increase is not independently measured for PPA-2; do not equate bulk viscosity with confirmed molecular binding geometry.

reference_evidence_units.quote: we can hard to say that these new developed sensors are exactly ATP-specific in the mammalian cells.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA probe series including TPA-PPA-2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: HepG-2 imaging and DAPI comparisons; Figs. 8-9.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors explicitly stop short of assigning cellular staining specifically to ATP, noting charge-mediated uptake and interactions with other bioanalytes.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Cell imaging does not validate in-cell ATP specificity. Prose gives 30 min while Fig. 8 and methods indicate 60 min/1 h.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the emission spectrum of TPA- PPA-3 changed negligibly upon the addition of ADP, AMP, and other anions
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA-PPA-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Detailed ATP-versus-ADP/AMP selectivity testing is presented for PPA-3.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is not a target-specific PPA-2 selectivity demonstration. Likewise, the 0.3 ppm detection limit and approximately 26-fold quantum-yield change in p.5 belong to PPA-3.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific viscosity response plus the source's explicit RIR interpretation supports bounded RIR; ATP-induced restriction is more tentative than the solvent test.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Under the frozen analyte-binding definition, ATP recognition is proposed to alter emission via multi-site association. This is a probe/analyte interaction, not macrocycle inclusion; PPA-2 geometry remains unverified.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the source's calculated donor-acceptor separation and probable ICT interpretation of solvent dependence, without adopting suspect gap units or asserting TICT.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Target-specific viscosity response plus the source's explicit RIR interpretation supports bounded RIR; ATP-induced restriction is more tentative than the solvent test.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-resolved aggregate size/packing or independent ATP-induced matrix confinement is demonstrated. Do not convert the proposed association/viscosity model into a proved aggregate structure.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established here; ground-state protonation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific exciton, excimer or new intermolecular emissive state is established; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: A single ambiguously conditioned lifetime does not establish an ATP-dependent rate balance.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet or metal/energy-transfer photophysics is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
